name: The First Unwriting
effect: A volume of space stops having happened and the ship's charts forget it with it.
options: Log the erasure|le-i-log#cost=stores:1;Rally the survey crew|le-i-rally#extra=morale:1

name: Dead Reckoning
effect: The log is a warning nobody has read and the Loom has already read it.

name: The Missing Berth
effect: A crew member's home port never existed; they remember it anyway.
options: Hold the survey line|le-i-transmit#extra=morale:1;Turn for the muster|le-i-silent#cost=stores:1

name: The Answering Silence
effect: The warning is answered by nobody who can still be answered.
options: Shelter in the dead zone|le-ii-shelter;Push deeper|le-ii-derelict#extra=stores:1

name: The Quiet Chart
effect: The survey continues and the crew stops asking about the berth that never was.
options: Shelter in the dead zone|le-ii-shelter#cost=morale:1;Push deeper|le-ii-derelict

name: The Dead Zone
effect: Systems fail one at a time and the Loom's voice arrives on every band.

name: The Derelict
effect: A hull with no crew and a full locker drifting since before the chart.

name: Salvage Rights
effect: The ally who guided you here asks only to keep their berth.

name: The Archivist's Offer
effect: Vane offers the ship's survival for one more revision of the world.
options: Bargain in bad faith|le-ii-bargain#extra=stores:1;Refuse him|le-ii-refuse#extra=morale:1;Abandon the voyage|le-end-abandon

name: Terms in Bad Faith
effect: The terms are a promise with a clause quietly removed.

name: The Loom Bleeds
effect: A revision comes apart and the Loom's core is briefly unguarded.

name: The Weave Advances
effect: The bargain holds and the ship is spared something older is spent instead.

name: Mutiny
effect: The captain refuses Vane and the crew must choose what refusing costs.

name: Ahead of the Weave
effect: The ship arrives before the revision closes and a charge is already spooling.
options: Set the charge|le-iii-approach#extra=charge:2;Hit the core now|le-end-ram#cost=hull:2

name: The Core
effect: The Loom's core is a room that remembers every version of you.
options: Finish the weave|le-end-reset;Unwrite the Loom|le-end-quiet#cost=charge:2;Ram the core|le-end-ram#cost=hull:3

name: The Voyage Abandoned
effect: You turn for home and the erasure follows you there.

name: The Long Erasure
effect: The Loom completes; the drowned homeland returns and the survey never happened.

name: A Quiet Chart
effect: The Loom is unwritten; the homeland stays drowned and the chart stays honest.

name: Ashlight, Ends
effect: The ship becomes the argument the crew could not make any other way.
